title: Apex Food Chain
description: Start as a tiny critter and devour smaller creatures to evolve step by step—dodge apex predators until you grow into the ultimate king of the food chain.
controls: Drag to steer around the ecosystem, eat smaller targets to level up, and avoid higher-tier predators.

zh-CN.title: 顶级食物链
zh-CN.description: 超上头大鱼吃小鱼进化顶级食物链：从小生物开局不断吞噬弱小进化变身，躲避天敌一路吃成称霸全场的顶级掠食者！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动控制生物移动，吞噬比自己弱小的目标不断进化升级，躲开强敌登顶食物链。
